title: protocol lifecycle, reconnectability, and operation observability
verified: started operation is durable and attached to execution
completed, failed, cancelled, and unknown outcomes are explicit
exact retry replays one durable result; changed retry is rejected
lost response is resolved by request identity after fresh process
operation and interrupted execution survive cold reopen
agent ownership is enforced independently of transport session
safe wire resources omit secrets, paths, SQL, and raw diagnostics
limitations: Pong records cancellation/interruption but does not kill external processes
real Claude JSONL completion is blocked by provider HTTP 403 quota exhaustion
